name: Independent Review
purpose: Conduct impartial, adversarial evaluation of code changes against contracts, anti-slop rules, security policies, and edge cases to clear G5.
whenToUse: Evaluating completed code changes prior to release or handoff (Gate G5 entry)
Performing adversarial quality audits on code generated by implementation subagents
Verifying that implementation strictly conforms to requirements without unauthorized scope expansion
Checking compliance with Mandatory Baseline Quality rules and anti-slop guidelines
prerequisites: Gate G4 completed with verified test execution logs and exit code 0
Git diff or branch comparison against base commit available

inputs.name: targetCommitOrDiff
inputs.description: Git commit hash, branch name, or diff range representing changes under review

inputs.name: requirementsContract
inputs.description: Approved requirements contract specifying acceptance criteria and scope boundaries

inputs.name: verificationEvidence
inputs.description: Execution evidence log from testing-and-verification skill

procedure.title: Impartial Diff and Scope Analysis
procedure.action: Inspect git diff across all modified files. Compare implemented functionality against requirements contract. Flag any unapproved features or scope expansion.

procedure.title: Anti-Slop and Baseline Policy Audit
procedure.action: Audit codebase against rules BL-001 through BL-007: check for gratuitous emoji, hardcoded mock values in prod paths, empty stub functions, and unapproved packages.

procedure.title: Adversarial Edge Case and Security Review
procedure.action: Evaluate handling of boundary conditions: empty inputs, integer overflow, network timeouts, invalid schema payloads, injection flaws, and race conditions.

procedure.title: Quality Evidence Verification
procedure.action: Verify that test and linting evidence is complete, legitimate, and reproducible. Confirm test coverage meets the profile threshold.

procedure.title: Defect Categorization and Triage
procedure.action: Classify discovered issues by severity: BLOCKING (prevents release), MAJOR (must fix before G6), MINOR (logged to technical debt backlog).

procedure.title: Independent Review Report Generation
procedure.action: Publish review findings in docs/validation/independent-review-report.md. Update contracts/quality/contract.json status to APPROVED or REJECTED.

expectedOutputs: Formal G5 decision (APPROVED or REJECTED) in contracts/quality/contract.json
New defect or tech debt items recorded in memory/state.json if non-blocking issues found

potentialFailures: Blocking functional bugs or regression defects discovered
Anti-slop violations detected in reviewed source files
Test evidence found to be incomplete or unverified
failureAndRecovery.recoveryStrategy: Reject Gate G5 transition immediately. Transition lifecycle FSM back to G4 (TASK_RETRY). Provide unambiguous reproduction steps and remediation guidance to implementation subagent.

verificationCriteria: Zero blocking defects remain unresolved in review report
Zero anti-slop violations present in the reviewed diff
Every requirement in the requirements contract is traced to verified implementation
contracts/quality/contract.json status reflects honest reviewer evaluation
